curated.tagline: OpenRouter eval harness for cheap orchestrator + worker stacks
curated.outcome: Measures whether cheap orchestrator and worker models pass real tasks, and prices every pass.

measured.label: Pass rate
measured.source: Orchestral run group planner-fix-2026-11-10, after the planner list-plan fix (duketopceo/orchestral PR #211)
measured.method: Cheapest pairing in the model catalog (deepseek-v4-flash-0731 orchestrating glm-5.3-flash), 4 tasks x 4 replicates, mechanical verdict with no LLM judge. Counted over all 16 runs started (passed / total). The two failures are both constraint-product-blurb validation failures. Before the fix, the same measurement scored 11 of 16 (69%) because 4 api-order-lookup runs died on a top-level JSON list plan.

measured.label: Cost per pass
measured.source: Orchestral run group planner-fix-2026-11-10, after the planner list-plan fix (duketopceo/orchestral PR #211)
measured.method: Total OpenRouter-reported cost of the group ($0.0162 over 16 runs) divided by the 14 passes, billed to the dedicated Orchestral eval key.

curated.description: Eval harness that tests whether a cheap orchestrator plus cheap workers can produce frontier-quality output through OpenRouter routing.

release.transcript: A launch film for orchestral, the OpenRouter eval harness for cheap orchestrator and worker stacks.

demo.transcript: A 20-second terminal recording: orchestral's leaderboard ranks orchestrator and worker pairings by pass rate and cost per pass, then the pairings report shows quality per dollar. Model names are anonymized.

curated.architecture: Prompt bench → orchestrator → worker pool → scoring → report
